data.one_liner: Linux implementation of the flutter_local_notifications plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides local notification support for Flutter apps running on Linux. It registers the Linux platform implementation used by the flutter_local_notifications package. Relies on dbus and ffi to communicate with the Linux notification daemon.
use_when: Building a Flutter app that targets Linux and needs local notifications
You already use flutter_local_notifications and want Linux support out of the box
avoid_when: Your app only runs on mobile/web and doesn't need Linux support
You require push notifications or advanced features not covered by the plugin
strengths: Handles Linux notification daemon via dbus
No extra setup beyond adding the dependency
weaknesses: Only works on Linux; no other platforms
Limited documentation beyond the main plugin

alternatives.name: flutter_local_notifications
alternatives.why_pick_it: Main package that includes this Linux implementation and works across all supported platforms
